annotations.title: Search homes for sale or to let

description: Live homes for sale or to let from participating UK estate agents in a town, outcode or postcode area, with price, bedrooms, type, one photo, the agent's link and when Homedex last checked it was still listed. Use for 'find me a 3-bed flat in Folkestone under £300k'. Homes only, unless commercial (shops, offices, industrial units) is asked for with property_type commercial or the commercial filter; commercial results have commercial: true. Up to 20 results, every agent taking turns (fair to all agents), each turn its most detailed then newest listing; pass sort for a plain price or date order, plus how many fit in all and the next 30 as one line each (more_matches): pick the homes that best fit what the person asked for.

added_since.description: Only homes Homedex first saw on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD), for 'what's new since…'

area.description: A town (Folkestone), outcode (CT20) or postcode (CT20 3TZ). Needed unless near_postcode is given

commercial.description: Shops, offices, industrial units and other business premises: exclude (the default, homes only), include (homes and commercial) or only (commercial only). Use only when the person asks for a shop, office, unit or commercial property

cursor.description: For more results: the next_cursor from the previous answer, same filters

keywords.description: Words the listing must mention, e.g. garden parking

near_postcode.description: Only homes near this full postcode (e.g. CT20 1AA), within within_miles

property_type.description: One kind of property. commercial: shops, offices, industrial units and other business premises (not homes)

sort.description: recent (the default: every agent taking turns so no one agent fills the list, each turn its most detailed then newest listing), cheapest first, most expensive first, or newest regardless of agent

within_miles.description: With near_postcode: how far from it, in miles (default 2, up to 10)

name: search_listings

display.description: Only in apps that show Homedex's home cards: how to show these homes

more_matches.description: The next homes that fit, one line each (Homedex number first): pick any that suit the person better, and use get_listing for details

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor, with the same filters, for more results; null when that's all

agent_url.description: Send every enquiry here: the listing on the agent's own website

claimed.description: true: the agency agreed to be on Homedex. false: listed from the agency's own website (facts and a link) before it joined

commercial.description: true: a shop, office, industrial unit or other business premises, not a home

distance_miles.description: Only with near_postcode: miles from it

last_checked.description: When Homedex last confirmed the home was still on the agent's website

photo.description: This home's own main photo. Show only this as its picture, never one from an image search; null means show none

total.description: How many homes fit in all, e.g. '312' or '500 or more'

title: Search homes for sale or to let
